sections.text_preview: In ADSL systems, certain modes are changed by sending a single tone or a combination of up to three tones simultaneously. sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: A single-chip ADSL analog front end realized in a 0.6m BiCMOS technology has been presented. The chip operates at 3.3 V except for the integrated line driver, which accepts 12 V.
